title: The Three Registers and the Four Days
description: T3 unfolds blessedness, wisdom, and power as one threefold pattern recognized at three registers — at the outermost (where they pass), in the order by which the rational stands, and in the Lord himself (where they are the Father, the life-bearing principle, and the call going forth). T4 unfolds the four great days by which the Lord goes forth toward the soul, each holding twelvefold completeness: the Lord in his inmost, the call in the vessel of light, the path of regeneration with its ten brothers, and divine truth shining as illumining wisdom — mirrored by four corresponding nights of the proprium's permitted forming. Together they establish how the divine outgoing is articulated across three and four registers of fullness.
